CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x72a04.m1_top_zips AS
WITH zip_agg AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_zip,
    COUNT(*) AS trips,
    ROUND(SUM(fare_amount), 2) AS total_fare
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
total_rev AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS total_rev FROM zip_agg
),
zip_rank AS (
  SELECT
    z.*, 
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY z.total_fare DESC) AS fare_rank,
    ROUND(
      SUM(z.total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY z.total_fare DESC, z.pickup_zip ASC) / t.total_rev * 100,
      2
    ) AS cumulative_share_pct
  FROM zip_agg z
  CROSS JOIN total_rev t
),
hour_counts AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_zip,
    HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hr,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip, HOUR(tpep_pickup_datetime)
),
busy AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_zip,
    hr AS busiest_hour,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_zip ORDER BY cnt DESC, hr ASC) AS rn
  FROM hour_counts
)
SELECT
  r.pickup_zip,
  r.trips,
  r.total_fare,
  r.fare_rank,
  r.cumulative_share_pct,
  b.busiest_hour
FROM zip_rank r
JOIN (SELECT pickup_zip, busiest_hour FROM busy WHERE rn = 1) b
  ON r.pickup_zip = b.pickup_zip
WHERE r.fare_rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.fare_rank;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM workspace.exam_x72a04.m1_top_zips;
